meta.title: GlobeSpeak Academy — English, with excellence
meta.description: An international online English academy: levels A1 to B2, live classes on Google Meet, personal guidance.

home.title: English, taught with the standards of great institutions.
home.subtitle: Four levels, from A1 to B2. Live classes on Google Meet, exclusive content, personal feedback. An invitation-only journey designed to help you progress.
home.levelsSubtitle: Each level is a dedicated space, aligned with the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR).
home.skillsTitle: All four skills, studied in depth
home.accessBody: To guarantee the quality of our classes, every application is reviewed by our teaching team, who assign you the right level.

auth.shellQuote: “To have another language is to possess a second soul.”

signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.subtitle: Sign in to continue your journey.
signIn.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

signUp.title: Request access
signUp.subtitle: Create your account: our team will review your application and assign your level.
signUp.name: Full name
signUp.consent: I accept the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy> and the processing of my data to manage my registration.
signUp.successBody: If this address is not already in use, a confirmation email has just been sent. Click the link inside to complete your application.

password.hint: At least 12 characters. A passphrase is ideal.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email address: if an account exists, you will receive a reset link.
forgot.sent: If an account is linked to this address, an email has just been sent. The link is valid for 30 minutes.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Choose a strong password. You will be signed out of all your devices.
reset.success: Your password has been changed. You can now sign in.
reset.missingToken: This reset link is invalid or incomplete.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app.

setup2fa.title: Secure your account
setup2fa.subtitleAdmin: Two-factor authentication is mandatory for administrators.
setup2fa.subtitle: Add a second layer of protection to your account.
setup2fa.step2: Scan this QR code with Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy…
setup2fa.step3: Enter the code shown to confirm
setup2fa.backupBody: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each one lets you sign in if you lose your phone.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.body: Your account must be verified before continuing. Didn't receive anything? Request a new email.
verifyEmail.sent: If a matching unverified account exists, a new email has just been sent.

pending.title: Your application is under review
pending.body: Thank you {name}. Our teaching team is reviewing your profile to assign the level that suits you. You will receive an email as soon as your access is activated.
pending.delay: Usual turnaround: less than 48 business hours.
pending.meanwhile: In the meantime, you can safely close this page.

REJECTED.title: Your application was not accepted
REJECTED.body: After review, we are unable to accept your application at this time.

SUSPENDED.title: Your account is suspended
SUSPENDED.body: Access to your space has been temporarily suspended.
